goal: consolidate 2 locations into one; origin ends at 0; no duplicate (LocationID,ProductID)

writes.desc: merge: add loc4 qty into loc7 rows for shared products
writes.sql: UPDATE t7 SET t7.Quantity = t7.Quantity + t4.Quantity FROM dbo.Inventory t7 JOIN dbo.Inventory t4 ON t4.ProductID = t7.ProductID AND t4.LocationID = 4 WHERE t7.LocationID = 7
writes.verify_sql: SELECT ISNULL(SUM(Quantity),0) FROM Inventory WHERE LocationID = 7

writes.desc: zero out loc4 rows for merged products (origin to 0)
writes.sql: UPDATE dbo.Inventory SET Quantity = 0 WHERE LocationID = 4 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Inventory i7 WHERE i7.LocationID = 7 AND i7.ProductID = dbo.Inventory.ProductID)
writes.verify_sql: SELECT ISNULL(SUM(Quantity),0) FROM Inventory WHERE LocationID = 4

writes.sql: UPDATE dbo.Inventory SET LocationID = 7 WHERE LocationID = 4 AND (InventoryID % 2 = 0) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Inventory iX WHERE iX.LocationID = 7 AND iX.ProductID = dbo.Inventory.ProductID AND iX.InventoryID <> dbo.Inventory.InventoryID)
writes.verify_sql: SELECT ISNULL(SUM(Quantity),0) FROM Inventory WHERE LocationID = 4
